verdict.rationale: Cake documents a 'flexible vesting engine' that automates cliffs, schedules, milestones and pauses. Vesting can be attached to founder or ordinary shares at issuance. The dashboard and MCP surface upcoming vesting events and vesting status from the live cap table, which shows vested and unvested amounts are tracked automatically. Missing for 10: any evidence of acceleration-on-exit (single/double trigger) support, detailed docs on configuring custom schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
